newsitem.title: USA: Limo company settles chauffeur suit.
newsitem.headline: Limo company settles chauffeur suit.

text.p: The Equal Employment Opportunity Commission said Thursday that one of New York's largest limousine services has agreed to settle a suit alleging almost all of its chauffeurs were white males.
Under the settlement, Smith Limousine Co. will pay $300,000 in back pay and interest to 10 African Americans and one woman who were denied jobs as chauffeurs.
Although Smith denied that it had descriminated against the job applicants, it signed a consent decree and entered into the agreement with the EEOC ending the suit filed in Manhattan federal court.
The decree also requires Smith to change its hiring practices and initiate goals for hiring African Americans and women.
